items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Frederick Brown had wanted the bellhop and I went to work around there working at night

ctx.x: So my uncle gave me my first pair of long pants to go to, and I went to work the following week. Frederick Brown had wanted the bellhop and I went to work around there working at night from 2 in the evening to 2 in the morning. I worked 12 hours during them days around there. Yeah. But he was making money. But the night shifts were the best because that's when everything was opening up and all the, you know, spokesmen coming through that going to different houses and that's where we used to make our money.
